inputs.goal: hire a senior backend engineer who can own our payments service

define-role.intake.summary: Review candidates' experience in distributed systems, payment rails, and on-call ownership. Evaluate technical depth through systems design and coding interviews. Assess ownership mindset and leadership potential. Recommend top candidate based on alignment with must-haves and team needs.

define-role.generate.draft: We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to lead our payments service. The ideal candidate will have deep experience in distributed systems and payment rails, with a proven track record of on-call ownership. This role requires strong systems design capabilities, coding proficiency, and the ability to own complex technical problems from end-to-end. The candidate should demonstrate leadership potential and be able to mentor junior engineers while driving technical excellence in our payments platform.
requirements: Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture
Proven experience with payment rails and financial systems
Strong on-call ownership and incident response capabilities
Systems design interview performance at senior level
Coding interview success with complex problem solving
Demonstrated ownership mindset and leadership potential
